name: UUGRN Unix/Linux Stammtisch
description: monthly regulars' table of the Unix User Group Rhein-Neckar
note: German; every 3rd Monday, next 21 Dec and 18 Jan
details:
Open monthly get-together of the Unix User Group Rhein-Neckar e.V. about FreeBSD, BSD, Unix, Linux and everything around them. Usually 10-15 people, newcomers of any level are explicitly welcome.

A social evening in a restaurant rather than a laptop session; food and drinks are paid by each guest. Dates come from the group's official calendar (Termine.ics); next ones 21 Dec 2026 and 18 Jan 2027.
